name: West Virginia
dueDateNotes: West Virginia follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: West Virginia applies graduated rates (2.11%-4.58%) to your federal AGI after a $2,000-per-person exemption; it has no separate standard deduction. Rates reflect the 2026 cut under SB 392. Single and married filers use the same brackets.
uniqueFacts: West Virginia cut its income tax rates again for 2026 under SB 392, with a new top rate of 4.58%.
West Virginia uses the same tax brackets for single and married-filing-jointly filers, which creates a marriage penalty for two-earner couples.
West Virginia has no state standard deduction; it starts from your federal income and gives a $2,000 exemption per person instead.
